basic_info.description: - Noe Valley - Well Maintained Stately Edwardian Duplex + Garage & Garden!  The Top Floor Flat with Skylights is Bright, and in Move in Condition, and has been staged as a Two Bedroom with Living Room, Formal Dining Room, Eat in Kitchen, Office, Full Bath, and Water Closet.  The First Level is a 5 room flat, and certainly could be used as a 3 Bedroom with Living Room, and Eat in Kitchen.  Both have Brilliant Hardwood Floors with Inlay, Decks off the back, Period Details, and Laundry / Laundry hook ups.  The Edwardian Faade with its Excellent Natural Color Scheme highlights the Period Detail and Flatters the Bay Windows.  The Garage easily accommodates one car, and could possibly be modified to service additional parking plus storage.  The 114 Foot Lot Depth provides for a Serene Oasis of a Large Yard / Garden that is the Coveted South Facing for maximum Sunlight year round.  This one is a Gem!  The assortment of professionally set up garden plantings can contain the following, Lemon Tree, Lime, Hass Avocado, Red Haven Peach, Pomegranate, Champagne Loquat, and potentially more. Other features include Concrete Perimeter Foundation, Upgraded 200 AMP electrical service, visible copper plumbing, Gas Ranges, Gas Heaters, Back Decks, almost all Double Pane Windows, and more!
